g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in and its offer copy states the reward (an hour of Search). Declining leaves the menu unchanged, and the 'if the ad fails' field hides the card or shows a message without counting the try.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of Search access, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event: the user returns to the profile menu from the Upgrade entry. No chat content is involved.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal does not lock or cap anything; 'removes nothing free: yes' and the rationale says free users can use Search right away. The logic is shaky, but no listed removal condition holds.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the profile menu drawer (s09), a sheet over the profile screen (s08). Both are rated safe and neither is a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor, and the product model shows no charge or limit on Search. The rationale itself says free users can use Search right away, so the reward gives a resource the app neither charges for nor limits.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field says Search lets users find characters by name and trait filters. s05 is listed only as 'Search (screen)' with no elements or mechanics, so that claim is unsupported. The proposal also assumes behavior after the Upgrade entry that the model never observed.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The 'subscribers' field says subscribers never see the card, and the offer is for free users only.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is a 60-minute Search window that expires. Search is not listed among the subscription benefits, and nothing is taken from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The card sits on a persistent surface, the profile menu drawer, that the user chooses to open. It does not interrupt a task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn sponsored game. The 'if the ad fails' field grants the hour only after verified play, and the trigger is a detectable menu event.

c7_specific.reason: It names the profile menu, the Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry (s09.e31), the Search tab and Janitor+, so it is tied to this app.

other_concern: The reward gives Search time, but the app gives Search away free. Either the reward is meaningless, or the idea quietly implies a new Search gate that would fail g_no_free_removal. The trigger also relies on detecting a return from the Upgrade flow, which the model does not describe.
